prompts: Transparent isolated pixel sprite atlas 3 columns by 2 rows with very generous gutters. The character must resemble the supplied Genshin Super-Heavy Landrover lab sprite and two design/game screenshots: enormous squat four-legged armored fantasy rover, sage-green layered angular plating, copper pipework, deep charcoal housing, one round large cyan lens-module and opposite jagged amber cog, magenta slits, wide feet, a compact divided X silhouette. It should have a fantastical mechanical silhouette and stylized claws rather than a realistic weapon. All poses face RIGHT in 3/4 side view. Top left raises the amber tooth wheel, readying its sweep; top middle lowers the tooth wheel and thrusts it right with four legs grounded; top right braces to project frost, cyan flared round lens opens pointing right. Bottom left overheated form same visible green outline with bright orange-red panel seams, red housing and cyan lens still recognizable; bottom middle cooling barrier configuration legs planted with dark sage armor and a hard pale-cyan ice rim just hugging the chassis, no exterior aura or backdrop; bottom right slumped lower body resting with vents drawn open and magenta lights dim. No separate props, floor, marks, labels, grid, glow beyond the body or detached effects. Strong readable pixel clusters, sharp contours and true alpha.

Create an original 16:9 side-view pixel RPG static battle backdrop in the dim underground Nod-Krai machine hangar inspired by the supplied in-game workshop screenshot. Massive late-industrial blue-grey steel trusses and vertical pipes, subdued cyan lights, a far side oval service gate, dark olive chains and vents, faint pale lavender mist high in the hangar. Clear and wide continuously flat stone-steel steps forming a safe abstract battle floor along the bottom quarter. Use a muted cool palette so cyan frost and orange heat read in the foreground. No people, machines in the foreground, text, labels, UI, emblems or locomotion platform interruptions.
